meta.title: Tony — Xiao Ming
meta.description: AI practitioner and content creator. Building agent workflows, AI writing, and video generation systems.

home.p1: I'm an AI practitioner and content creator with 7 years of software engineering experience, based in Shenzhen. I run the WeChat publication 「Tony's Tea House」, and focus on AI writing systems, video generation, and automated agent workflows.
home.p2: At work I lean on Claude; day to day I use OpenClaw. I also explore quant trading pipelines, local LLM deployment, and Japanese (JLPT N2). Motto: if an agent can do it, don't do it by hand.

about.title: About
about.p1: Hi, I'm Tony — also Xiao Ming. With 7 years in software, I work in AI and create content under 「Tony's Tea House」, based in Shenzhen.
about.p2: My core focus is building AI writing, video generation systems, and automated agent workflows for real business use. I'm Mac-first, fluent in Feishu/Lark, and comfortable across Windows and Linux.
about.p3: Stack: Claude, OpenClaw, Kimi API, Codex, IBKR quant pipelines, Python automation, and TradingView + Claude AI trading bots. Claude for work; OpenClaw for daily life.
about.p4: I'm studying the full agent-engineer skill stack, AI video generation, local LLM deployment, and automated quant systems — plus Japanese JLPT N2. I run and cycle regularly. Recently engaged; settled in Shenzhen.
about.p5: I prefer clear, beginner-friendly writing that still goes deep — translating dense finance and AI jargon into plain language, and organizing knowledge with Markdown, mind maps, and Anki.
